name: 4d-blog-engine
description: 4D Blog Engine — operationalizes the 4D AI Fluency Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) for content production. v0.5.0 hardens the writer-facing flow against the friction points observed in a real end-to-end run: /publish is rewritten to work end-to-end (vendored scripts/smart_quotes.py for reliable YAML/JSON-LD-preserving typographer's quotes, auto-detects posts/images subfolders, mounts the repo if not mounted, supports --draft); /blog-start now mounts the publishing repo explicitly so /publish never has mid-flow friction; the earned-secret stall enforces deterministic checks (length, concrete artifact required, platitude pattern rejection) with a 3-round hard cap instead of model-judgment-by-feel; hero-image proposals lead with story-grounded options (concrete nouns from the post) and only offer abstract metaphor as a fallback. v0.4.0 added /blog-voice (multi-voice supported) and unhardcoded all preset-voice references. v0.3.x stripped backend infrastructure out of the writer-facing setup. v0.3.x stripped backend infrastructure out of the writer-facing setup. v0.2.0 added the lifecycle commands. Pipeline: takes a base document and an angle question; runs a 30-day discourse sweep across reddit, X, Hacker News, Substack, Facebook, Quora, podcasts, and academic sources; layers a /council:deliberate synthesis pass; builds a verified bibliography with AI-generated abstracts; drafts the blog post in the writer's voice using the research-pipeline content-writer; runs a two-tier anti-AI-slop pass (deterministic linter + LLM structural review with a second-pass audit); and ships through a nonce-bound Release Owner Gate scoring against a 100-point rubric. On a clean gate, produces a publication-ready blog post, a long-form LinkedIn article (full mirror, blog stays canonical), and a short hook-led LinkedIn teaser with a 3-axis scorecard. Trigger phrases: 'write a blog post from this document', 'derive a blog from this whitepaper', '/4d-blog-engine', 'set up the blog plugin', 'publish this post', 'release-owner gate'. Implements the Release Owner Gate from MoxyWolf's 'Beyond the Prompt' whitepaper.
